subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof before this branch remains a landing candidate, or explicitly override the proof gate based on Codex source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests?
rationale: External PR real-behavior proof is still mock/source-only, and current OpenClaw projection makes the raw `exec_command` producer route a maintainer proof-sufficiency choice rather than something code inspection alone can settle.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a linked artifact showing both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

options.title: Override proof based on source contract
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the sibling Codex source contract and focused helper tests as enough despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause this branch and keep the issue canonical
options.body: If no live producer evidence is likely, pause or eventually close this branch while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93482 open for a proven replacement.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a linked artifact showing both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the Codex app-server projection and shared agent warning surface involved in the proof question.
